source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: In a lecture-notes workflow, what role does the transcript of the current lecture play?

options.text: The reusable procedure for all future runs
options.feedback: A transcript contains lecture content, not the general instructions for turning any suitable transcript into notes.

options.text: Metadata describing when to select the skill
options.feedback: Metadata describes the skill's role. The current transcript supplies the material for one use of it.
The transcript provides the source content to which the reusable procedure is applied.

options.text: An output generated by the notes procedure
options.feedback: The notes are the output in this workflow. The transcript is supplied as source material.
